questions.reference:
import re
def validate_citations(spans, stored, principal, grants):
    by_id = {row['id']:row for row in stored}
    seen = set()
    for span in spans:
        label, row = span['citation_id'], span['chunk']
        a,b = span['start'],span['end']
        if (not isinstance(label,str) or re.fullmatch(r'S[1-9][0-9]*',label) is None or label in seen
            or by_id.get(row['id']) != row
            or (principal,row['tenant_id'],row['document_id'],row['version']) not in grants
            or type(a) is not int or type(b) is not int or not 0<=a<b<=len(row['text'])
            or span['quote'] != row['text'][a:b]):
            raise ValueError('invalid authorized stored span')
        seen.add(label)
    return True
